name: Yorozuya Tatsuya
source:
[url=/c112731]Hina[/url]’s older brother. A student at the delinquent-filled so-called “Badman Academy,” he is also the leader of DREAD.

Similar to Hina, he isn’t picky about the methods he uses to earn money for reasons of his own and doesn’t hesitate to resort to violence at times.

With the Yakuza at his back, his money-making activities are a far cry from your average student’s.

He sees [url=/c112736]Itsuki[/url] as a friend, and Itsuki trusts him in return.

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/criminal-border-2nd-offence/]Kagura Games[/url]]
